quotes.author: Bobby Kitsios
quotes.text: We used NYC WATER CRUISES for our wedding on Oct 13, 2024. I thought the scenery would be a beautiful backdrop for our wedding but little did I know how great the staff would be and how much it would contribute to the day. The guests (82) were raving about the food and the service. The staff was very friendly and accommodating.It was a perfect day for us and our friends and family. Highly recommend.

quotes.author: Emily Johnson
quotes.text: We booked NYC WATER CRUISES for my parents’ 40th anniversary celebration. Everything was perfectly organized — from the delicious food to the stunning views of the skyline. The crew went above and beyond to make it special. Truly unforgettable!

quotes.author: Sarah Thompson
quotes.text: We hosted a family reunion on board, and it couldn’t have been better. There was plenty of space, the food options satisfied everyone (even the picky eaters), and the kids loved being on the water. Thank you for the amazing memories!

quotes.author: Michael Rodriguez
quotes.text: Our company chose NYC WATER CRUISES for a corporate event, and it was a hit! The atmosphere was professional yet fun, the staff was attentive, and the boat itself was elegant. We’ve already decided to book again next year.

quotes.author: Daniel Lee
quotes.text: I surprised my wife with a dinner cruise for her birthday. The city lights at night created such a romantic mood. The service was impeccable, and the live music was a beautiful touch. We’ll remember this evening forever.

quotes.author: Christopher Williams
quotes.text: Attending a holiday cruise with friends was the highlight of our December. The decorations were festive, the drinks were fantastic, and the staff made us feel like VIP guests all night long. Can’t wait to go again!
